title: James Webb reveals a massive cosmic structure that challenges our understanding of the Universe
caption:
The James Webb Space Telescope has discovered a galaxy cluster that defies current cosmological models. By using gravitational lensing, scientists found that this ancient structure is far denser than it should be, suggesting the early universe evolved much faster than we thought.

Source: Sciencedaily - James Webb reveals a massive cosmic structure that challenges our understanding of the Universe
